entries.0cd21ec86ef75bc3: This is the only business of the company's group (single segment), in which it manufactures, sells and rents road safety materials, building disaster-prevention products, security equipment, protective gear, and sign media such as various signboards and signs. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥29,857 million. The company and 15 consolidated subsidiaries make up the group, and the core company, Green Cross Co., Ltd., accounts for more than 10% of consolidated revenue. Also, consolidated subsidiary Toa Anzen Shisetsu Co., Ltd. changed its trade name to ＴＯＡ Co., Ltd. effective May 1, 2026.
entries.297054eb79841a97: A Fukuoka-based holding company that sells and rents safety equipment used on roads and at construction sites, and sign media such as signboards and signs.
entries.314b70b820e2d79a: It sells safety equipment products, including construction signboards and signs, temporary protective fences, security lights and warning lights, disaster-prevention supplies, and environmental improvement supplies. Sales for the fiscal year ended April 2026 were ¥12,082 million, making it the group's largest product category.
entries.7703629a3f9bfd42: Construction contractors such as construction companies
entries.a7cc5245817e74f2: A rental business for safety equipment products, lending temporary protective fences, security equipment and other items to construction sites and similar locations. Sales for the fiscal year ended April 2026 were ¥8,814 million.
entries.e9abec2721c9dd67: It manufactures and sells sign media such as signboards and signs, and also performs ＬＥＤ and neon sign installation and indoor and outdoor signboard installation work. Sales for the fiscal year ended April 2026 were ¥8,960 million.
